question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**produce**" means to create or bring forth something, especially in the context of generating energy or power. (उत्पादित करना)
 
• Example: Factories produce goods for consumers.
 
• In the context, **"The industry also uses fossil fuels to produce power and heat needed by industrial processes" **means that the industry uses fossil fuels to create the power and heat necessary for its operations.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**produce**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Coal and natural gas-fired power plants generate electricity. Oil-based products such as gasoline, diesel fuel, and aviation fuel provide most of the energy used in transportation. The industry also uses fossil fuels to** produce**__ power and heat needed by industrial processes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Probate (संपत्ति की वसीयत की जांच और प्रमाणन)**: The official proving of a will.

 
 
• **Example: **The probate process ensures that the deceased's assets are distributed according to their will.
 
 
 
• **Permit (अनुमति देना)**: To allow something to happen, give authorization.
 
 
• **Example: **The authorities permit fishing in this area only during certain months.
 
 
 
• **Peruse (ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ना)**: To read or examine something with great care.
 
 
• **Example: **Please peruse the document before signing.

The correct answer is **Option 3.**</div&g
